description: Two men in flat caps and work gloves operate a large core-drilling rig in a dim, cramped chamber. An electric motor on a vertical stand drives a long cylindrical core bit cutting into a brick wall, with water running down the bricks and a plastic water bottle on the floor. Through the drilled openings, gold-toned cabinets or safe-deposit boxes are visible, lit by a single hanging lamp. There is no legible text, no frame, and nothing graphic.
